pairs_with_lean: QOU/QBeta/FiveTwoSaddleSumRule.lean section 7d (12 theorems, sorry-free, standard axioms)
retracts: the never-committed claim that the distribution (Kubert) family is VACUOUS on the Galois sum, i.e. that summing it gives `A = A`. False -- see G1 (reversed generating polynomial) and G4/G8 (the inflated polynomials are reducible, so the inflated sum is not one atomic unknown).

gates.claim: `prod_i (1 - X_i z) = z^d R(1/z)` IS the highest-first coefficient list read low-to-high, with NO reversal -- checked against the literal product over `polyroots` at three points on four polynomials. The second half is the negative control: the reversed convention must FAIL, because reversing it is the natural-looking error that produced the retracted no-go

the integral route agrees with an INDEPENDENT computation (mpmath `polylog` at the roots) on all eight polynomials in play, and the hypothesis it needs -- no root in [1,inf), Li2's cut -- is verified two ways that must agree. The negative controls X^3-X-1 and X^4-X-1 DO have such a root and must be rejected, so the screen is not decoration

the whole ladder is the POWERS OF ONE GENERATOR `c` (root of X^3+X^2-1, c = 1/rho with rho the plastic number): c^2 gives Q so B = C_2, c^3 gives P so A = C_3, and c^5 gives the reflection since 1-c = c^5. Minimal polynomials computed by exact integer Newton identities, and every discriminant is -23*square -- one and the same cubic field

P(X^3) = X^9-2X^6+3X^3-1 and Q(X^2) = X^6-X^4+2X^2-1 are BOTH REDUCIBLE, with the stated exact integer factorizations. This is the fact that refutes the retracted no-go: the Li2-sum over the nine (resp. six) numbers is not one new unknown, it splits along the factors. Both cubic factors have discriminant -23 -- the same field as y

the two distribution relations hold: A = C_3 = 3*(C_1 + E) (triplication) and B = C_2 = 2*(C_1 + D) (duplication). Evaluated at dps 40 AND 60 so that a single-precision quadrature coincidence cannot pass -- the residual must fall with the working precision, not merely be small once

both reflections close in elementary terms with PRINCIPAL logs and no branch correction: C_2 + C_3 = pi^2/2 - sum log y log(1-y) over the y-orbit, and C_1 + C_5 = the same over the c-orbit. `1-c^3 = c^2` and `1-c = c^5` are why these two land inside the tower instead of introducing fresh orbits

THE ROUTE DOES NOT CLOSE, and this is a proof rather than an impression. Six unknowns (C_1, C_2, C_3, C_5, D, E), four relations. The functional that reads off A = C_3 lies in the row space iff rank is unchanged when it is stacked on. It is not: rank goes 4 -> 5, so NO combination of reflection + duplication + triplication over this tower determines A

the retracted claim, isolated. The change of variables IS true: S_9 = A/3 to 40+ digits. The retracted step was reading that as `A = A`, which requires S_9 to be one atomic new unknown. It is not -- S_9 = C_1 + E with BOTH parts nonzero and C_1 far from S_9. So the relation connects genuinely different quantities and the family is NOT vacuous

verdict.structure: the tower is the powers of one generator c (root of X^3+X^2-1, c = 1/rho, rho the plastic number): B = C_2, A = C_3, and the reflection of C_1 is C_5 because 1-c = c^5. Every minimal polynomial has discriminant -23*square: one cubic field throughout.
verdict.relations: four, all verified numerically here: C_2+C_3 and C_1+C_5 elementary (reflection), C_2 = 2(C_1+D) (duplication), C_3 = 3(C_1+E) (triplication).
verdict.no_go: six unknowns, four relations, and the functional reading off A is NOT in the row space -- rank 4 -> 5 when stacked. So distribution + reflection over this tower provably cannot determine A. Unlike the retracted claim, this is a rank computation, not an integral identity.
verdict.not_closed_by_this: the five-term relation, Landen (Route 3), and any relation using a root not of the form c^m are all untouched.
